title: Cohomological dimension of a separably closed point
statement: If $K$ is a separably closed field then $\kuncd(\Spec(K))=0$.

proof.text: Unfold `def-kun-cd`, which defines the numerical dimension as the `ENat.sInf` of the set of finite natural bounds. The Mathlib lemma `ENat.sInf_eq_zero` reduces equality with zero to membership of zero in this set. Choose the witness natural number `n = 0`; the equality `0 = (0 : ℕ∞)` is immediate, and `lem-sf-separably-closed-torsion-cd`, in its Lean form `hasTorsionEtaleCohomologicalDimensionLE_zero_of_isSepClosed`, supplies the required torsion étale cohomological bound. Thus zero belongs to the defining set and the dimension is zero.
